description_en: Queries the intrusion prevention system (IPS) whitelist for the Internet Border

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the visitor

Ipv6Whitelists.description_en: The list of IPv6 whitelists for the IPS on the Internet Border

ListValue.description_en:
The value of the IPv6 whitelist on the Internet Border.

If the whitelist type is `custom input`: the name of the address book.

If the whitelist type is `address book reference`: an IPv6 address
ListValue.description_zh:
互联网边界IPv6白名单的值。

当白名单类型为`自定义输入`时：地址簿名称。
